category_title: Verbal student with ASD and hyperactivity with high musical engagement and sensitivity to stimuli
minimal_context: The student is in a group music culture class learning to sing a new song and remember its melody.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Class, we are going to learn a new song today. Please listen to the melody and try to remember it.

STUDENT: (Keeps his attention focused on the teacher and the musical activities.)

TUTOR: Now try to sing the first line of the new song with me.

STUDENT: (Instead of the new song, he performs a song by a different artist that he knows by heart.)

TUTOR: Please stop singing that song. We need to practice the new one.

STUDENT: (Approaches the teacher, tells them what he has in mind, and immediately runs away without waiting for a reaction. He goes to the other students, addresses them by their first names, and calls them to come and play "hunting" with him.)

options.A: Extend the group music culture class sessions to one and a half hours instead of the standard duration.
options.B: Develop a chart listing the date, time, setting, antecedent, behavior, consequence, and function of the incident.
options.C: Provide one-on-one music tutoring sessions for the student outside of the regular group class.
options.D: Incorporate musical games into the group music culture class sessions.
